abstract: In this paper, we introduce SPHERE (Spatial and Perceptual Human Evaluation and Rating Estimator), a multidimensional no-reference perceptual evaluation framework for binaural speech. SPHERE defines nine distinct perceptual and spatial attributes that characterize the immersive listening experience. We detail the crowdsourcing protocol and evaluation template used to collect ground-truth human ratings. To demonstrate the tractability of automating this framework, we evaluate six baseline configurations across single-branch and Siamese architectures utilizing Mel-spectrograms, complex STFTs, and pretrained spatial embeddings (PhaseCoder). Experimental results demonstrate that these baseline estimators achieve strong correlation with human subjective ratings, proving the feasibility of automated multidimensional spatial audio quality assessment.

oneSentenceThesis: SPHERE 针对双耳语音同时做九个感知的无参考预测，用众包听音得到真值，再以单分支与孪生卷积循环基线验证可行性，最好的片段级平均 PCC 为 0.706 而系统级孪生结构占优，但结论只在同类耳机采集与严格防泄漏划分下成立。
